name: FarScream
author: Heaven3D (models: provided by lolgg313, see ASSETS_LICENSE.md)
description: An open-island shooter map generator. One click makes a tropical island with military camps, a radio outpost, islander villages in the jungle, a plane crash and a shipwreck, all furnished with bunkers, tents, barrels, crates and trucks. Shoot with a pistol, loot the MP5s and ammo soldiers drop, drive both trucks in third person, blow up fuel barrels and liberate the island. Includes the 'FarScream' template.
